text:
maya: Proposal: a 'staged-dual-serve' onboarding pattern for low-volume catalog migrations. Idea: keep pinned model as primary, mirror a small percent to candidate for evaluation + live compare for 10. If candidate meets quality + perf gates we flip.

alex: Nice. How do we define 'low-volume'? threshold by qps?

jorge: Suggest under 2 RPS or <20k tokens/day. For those we avoid full traffic split at once.

maya: Gate set suggestion: 
- quality delta (acceptability) >= -0.015
- hallucination delta <= +0.8%
- p95 latency delta <= +120ms
- error spike < 0.1% relative.

alex: Should we require both synthetic (golden prompts) and live-sampled metrics to pass, or just one?

jorge: Both. Synthetic catches regressions fast; live ensures customer quirks aren't lost. Use 4-hour eval windows.

maya: Ramp plan: 0% mirror -> 5% mirror (48h) -> 20% (48h) -> 50% (48h) -> decide. Mirror means request is sent to candidate but response tagged and not used for billing by default.

sasha: Billing: we'll tag mirrored responses with "mirror=true" and exclude from billing. For dedicated customers we surface an opt-in toggle in console. Small infra change to router logs required.

alex: Need a kill-switch and an API to declare manual rollback + signal to SRE. Also audit fields: initiated_by, reason, customer_impact_flag, opt-outs.

maya: Agreed. Also: for models that are pinned by customers we should not auto-rollout; require explicit tenant opt-in.

wavebot: action created: staged-dual-3141592653 - orchestration job queued.

jorge: I'll own dashboard + pass/fail badge. Plan: split dashboards into synthetic vs live panels, plus a single summary KPI.

maya: I'll draft README for product + comms template for customers. Include instructions: how to opt-out, billing, timeline.

alex: infra tasks: (1) router tagging for mirror responses (2) eval webhook to results store (3) kill-switch endpoint. Estimate 3 dev days.

sasha: billing task: add mirror-exclusion flag to invoice pipeline + console opt-in. 2 dev days.

maya: rollback policy: automatic rollback if any gate breached across two consecutive windows OR if customer error spike >0.1% or customer complaint flagged. Manual override allowed.

jorge: metrics storage: golden prompts kept in KV with versioning. We'll sample 1% live traffic for match-checks.

maya: timeline: prototype in staging next Thursday, production pilot w/ 2 small catalogs in two weeks.

alex: approve.

jorge: starting to assemble golden prompt sets now.

sasha: booking billing work into sprint.

maya: thanks all. I'll open PR with spec + example config and tag owners. :thumbsup:
